title: Names: the capitalised headwords of the AB 2018 word list (places, demonyms, peoples, languages, religion, titles, institutions)

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name exactly as the source prints it, capital letters included. For AB 2018 rows it equals the lemma of the word_id row.

fields.name: word_id
fields.description: The id of the headword in lexicon/words that this name is (pap-...). Empty only for a name that is not a headword of the word list.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What the name is, by the capitalisation rules of AB 2018 §9.3-9.4 (gazette pp. 30-32). Geographic names (§9.3 e): continent, region (a part of the world, a historical land, a mountain range, a pole), country (including former ones), island, place (a city, town, district or neighbourhood), water (an ocean, sea or river). demonym: the adjective, inhabitant or language name derived from a geographic name (§9.3 g). people: a people or tribe and its derivatives (§9.3 j). language: a language not named after a place (§9.3 h). religion: a deity or a name for one, a religious figure, a prayer, a scripture or another religious name (§9.3 d). holiday: a holiday or religious day (§9.3 i). title: a form of address, title or dignity and its abbreviation (§9.3 b, k, m; §9.4). planet and zodiac (§9.3 e). institution: an institution, organisation, business or brand (§9.3 f). person: a named person or figure (§9.3 a). other: anything else, or a name whose meaning the source leaves open.

fields.name: related
fields.description: Ids of the names this one is derived from, '; '-separated: a demonym's place (Arubano > Aruba). Only when the word list itself makes the link obvious.

fields.name: en
fields.description: English name(s) or gloss, '; '-separated; a short description in parentheses when needed

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the reviewers, separated by '; '. Required when status is reviewed.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Printed page number(s), e.g. 38 or 38-39, roman for front matter. For AB 2018, the word-list page.

$comment: Frictionless Table Schema plus x-papiamento extensions read by tools/validate.py. See _meta/conventions.md.
